archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO (Nordic Sports Athletic Precision)
language: Norwegian (Bokmål) with authentic sports & inventory terminology

layout_and_spacing.mobile_responsive: Mobile-first responsive drawer + bottom bar, 100% elastic layout
layout_and_spacing.bento_strategy: MODE B: High Density Grid (Dashboard / Inventory Data)
layout_and_spacing.card_style: Flat surface with crisp 1px border (#E2E8F0), subtle hover shadow, 8px border-radius

loans_and_returns.title: Utlån & Historikk
loans_and_returns.calculated_logic: Automatisk beregning av skyldig beløp (Pris x Antall utlånt). Ved registrert retur nullstilles skyldig beløp og beholdningen økes automatisk.

component_guidelines.data_tables: Use Shadcn Table components with sticky headers, pagination, search input, status badges, and action menus (Drop-down / Edit / Delete / Return)
component_guidelines.forms: Use Shadcn Input, Select, Checkbox, Dialog, Form components with proper validation states and clear Norwegian labels
component_guidelines.dialogs: Modal overlays for Utlån, Retur, Nytt utstyr, Varetelling, and Logo-opplasting with solid or high-opacity crisp backdrop blur
component_guidelines.toasts: Use Sonner for quick notifications (e.g., 'Utlån registrert', 'Retur fullført - skyldig beløp slettet', 'Eksport til Excel fullført')
component_guidelines.charts: Recharts or Shadcn chart components for inventory value distribution and monthly equipment loan activity

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the complete UI in React for UTSTYRSROMMET covering all requested pages and modules in seamless single-page application router or view tabs.

Implement real working client-side calculated logic: automatic skyldig beløp calculation on loan checkouts, immediate clearing of debt upon return, live stock balance updates, and search/filter across all tables.
Ensure realistic mock data for Norwegian sports clubs (e.g. 'Stabæk Fotball Junior U15', 'Koll IL Håndball', 'Draktsett Hjemme', 'Kjeglesett', 'Ballnett Adidas', 'Medisinveske').
Include Excel/CSV export functionality using client-side download utility (e.g., blob/xlsx or clean CSV generator).
Provide full data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='add-equipment-btn', data-testid='return-loan-btn', data-testid='team-select').
Ensure dark/light mode toggle support and high legibility across mobile screens and desktop monitors.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid_requirement: All interactive buttons, input fields, selects, tables, and modal triggers MUST have clear data-testid attributes in kebab-case.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.responsive_rule: Mobile-first responsive design; sidebar collapses to drawer or top bar on small screens.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast_rule: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 text contrast on light and dark surfaces. Set explicit hover text colors.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_transparent_overlays: Never use completely transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, popovers, or sticky headers.
